title: Whole years of service
statementMd:
For each employee show first name and completed years of service as of 2024-06-30 (round down).

Expected columns: `first_name`, `years`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT first_name, CAST((julianday('2024-06-30') - julianday(hire_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS years FROM employees;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
